The '''Illuminated Aquean''' was an exclusive [[Casino/Legends|casino]] located on the resort [[Planet/Legends|world]] on [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]].

==Description==
Massive, heavily-fortified, [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] fish tanks lined the walls, providing a serene source of entertainment. The casino dazzled in the night, when glow beams illuminated the colorful aquatic creatures.

[[File:Amira_Nasrabi_G8.jpg|thumb|left|140px|Amira Nasrabi, owner of the Illuminated Aquean]]

==History==
The casino was operated by [[Amira Nasrabi]] during the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. She hired an intimidating security force composed of bulky [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] in order to protect the delicate artificial ecosystem. Nasrabi required that these guards acted with impeccable manners, so as to not frighten potential customers.
